correctness.rationale: An interrupted attempt at state i has success probability p_i=E exp(-rS_i) and expected duration (1-p_i)/r. The exact two-equation renewal system has determinant ab+c(a+b-2ab)>0; its average inverse yields the announced rational mean. Symbolic differentiation gives -(a-b)^2/[2r(ab+c(a+b-2ab))^2], establishing all endpoints and equality cases. The Brownian ring discounted hitting transform uniquely solves D u''=r u with boundary u(0)=u(L)=1. Reproduced symbolic identities, 120 exact rational samples and 20 independently constructed killed cycle-generator checks using the bundled verify.py. The proof, not numerical evidence, establishes all quantifiers.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies a complete and operationally motivated two-site correlation-control law, not a narrow arbitrary calculation: all policies share both reset-alarm intensity and unconditioned site marginals, yet anticorrelation alone strictly improves mean capture unless the sites have equal single-attempt success. The exact Brownian ring strictness boundary and closed-form iid-to-alternating gain give a measurable consequence and guide which site pairs benefit. No claim is made for full-distribution stochastic dominance or general policy optimality.
